_note: Round 120 (Robert, 2026-10-13): 'the initial quest ignition can give the recipe for the initial item plus the next one each in line giving the next items recipe. This quest will eventually require all the other crafting aspects of the game to complete fully.' Seven pieces. Each step: a stock to shape (family), what the other crafts must have made or found first (prep), the craft skill needed, gold. The smith reads the next recipe only once the last piece is made. Scripts: scripts/systems/Heirloom.gd. Dev writes the words.
name: The Heirloom of the Unbroken Line

pieces.name: Cuirass
pieces.recipe: Shape a cuirass from iron. Plain work, but the line starts here: nothing else will take its shape.
pieces.done: The first plate rings true. The smith turns it in the light. "Now the shoulders. Silver, and a salve to pad them -- someone who heals has to have touched this."

pieces.name: Pauldrons
pieces.recipe: Silver pauldrons, padded with two healing salves that you made or had made. The padding must be your own.
pieces.done: Shoulders on the frame. "The arms next: hide to bind them and a treatment oil -- a qi pill, ground fine."

pieces.name: Vambraces
pieces.recipe: Vambraces of hide, set with a qi pill dissolved into the binding. An alchemist's hand is needed.
pieces.done: The arms are done. "Now bone for the legs, and a dye pressed from spirit herbs -- plants from someone who knows them."

pieces.name: Greaves
pieces.recipe: Greaves of bone, dyed with four spirit herbs. Herbalism, not just smithing.
pieces.done: The legs stand. "Boots now. Hide, and the sizing from cave carp -- a river or a pond, someone patient."

pieces.name: Boots
pieces.recipe: Boots of hide, sized with cave carp. You will need to fish.
pieces.done: The boots are the first that fit. "Now the stone. A ring with jade -- a jeweller's work, set to hold what the others carry."

pieces.name: Ring
pieces.recipe: A silver ring set with rough jade, cut and set by a jeweller (your hands, jewelcrafting 3).
pieces.done: The ring catches the light and holds it. "One more. The cowl. Hide, and what you have learned."

pieces.name: Cowl
pieces.recipe: A cowl of hide, lined with ore you mined yourself. Every craft has been in this: now it is yours.
pieces.done: The last piece is set on the frame and the whole line seems to breathe. "It will wake as you do," the smith says. "Feed it what the deep gives you, and it will grow with you."
